title: Deploying a fully-equipped Mobile Medical Ambulance across Vasai-Virar
description: To combat the lack of healthcare infrastructure across underserved communities in Vasai-Virar, we are funding a state-of-the-art Mobile Medical Clinic. This ambulance will be equipped with diagnostic tools, emergency care equipment, and a pharmacy to serve over 10,000 underprivileged residents monthly across Virar & Vasai.
